title: What will you build?
description: Describe a project, and the AI agent of your node builds it: a Web4 swarm of A2A agents, a large full-stack app or an app factory.

rootHome.heading: What will you build?
rootHome.sub: Describe it in your own words. The agent of your node builds it for you.

cards.title: Create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents
cards.text: The agents of your elements find each other and agents of other nodes, agree on the work and are paid through Lagrix.
cards.task: I want to create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents.
cards.more: Choose this to work more efficiently and get paid for your expertise without hunting for clients. Create an agent by voice: a driver if you have a car, a cook if you sell your dishes. On the free Web4 internet every person has agents for any task. They find other agents and agree on the work on your behalf, with no platform in between.

cards.title: Create a large full-stack app
cards.text: From idea to money 99% faster. Sign-in, data, design and blocks are already in the node, so the agent builds only your product.
cards.task: I want to create a large full-stack app.
cards.more: A real app built with Claude Code needs many services: sign-in, a database, access roles, design and much more. The hard part is putting them together in the right order. That is already done here. You get a ready architecture and add only your own ideas to this solid core. Choose this to grow a reliable product that holds high load, on a server or on your own computer.

cards.title: Create an app factory
cards.text: Make your own versions of popular products: the node studies how they work with reverse engineering and builds yours on their ideas.
cards.task: I want to create an app factory with my own versions of popular products.
cards.more: It may seem everything has been invented already: teams worked on many products for years, and we are grateful for their ideas. Ideas and principles are not protected by copyright, so building your own on them is legal. The node studies how a popular product works, and in a few hours you assemble your own solution with your own code and design. Choose this to create ten or a hundred such products on a server or a home computer.

cards.title: Create agents for a family or a team
cards.text: One architect gives everyone an element of their own. A person creates a Telegram bot and simply talks to the agent, never opening the computer.
cards.task: I want to create agents for my family or my team.
cards.more: Many people have heard what AI can do but never let it into their lives: even ChatGPT feels hard to them, and they cannot build an agent of their own on the usual platforms. Here one architect is enough. They set up an element for each person; the person signs in as its administrator, creates a Telegram bot and from then on simply talks to it. The agent becomes a deep memory, a personal coach, a household budget or a teacher of a foreign language, programming and AI. It can also sell the person's services: rides, help around the house, home cooking to order. Everyone works on their own Claude subscription. Choose this to make the life of a family or a team more efficient, with no central servers living at your expense.

cards.title: Create a content factory
cards.text: A channel for every platform, author portraits and posts in their voices. The node reads the response to every publication and catches hot topics first.
cards.task: I want to create a content factory for my channels.
cards.more: People run their social networks from a chat window, and it works. A node does more: every channel gets its own agent, an element of author portraits writes in the voices you admire, the numbers of every post come back and show what works on each platform, and a scout watches social networks, Telegram channels, YouTube and the news to catch a topic while it rises. Every publication waits for your yes.

cards.title: Create your own agents
cards.text: A coach, a dietitian, an economist, an investor, a keeper of important dates. Say in Telegram what you need, and the agent finds the best way.
cards.task: I want my own agents to help me with my goals.
cards.more: Your own agents work for you alone: a coach for your training, a dietitian for your meals, an economist for your budget, an investor for your savings, a keeper of the dates you must not miss, like a tax return or a car service. Each remembers everything you tell it, keeps your photos and documents and talks to you from your phone. Say what you need: the agent looks for the best method, proposes it, and then works in the chat or on a page of its own.

reply.text: Your request will be sent to development as soon as you finish signing in to Claude Code. You will now be taken to a page where you can sign in. Below you will find a button to continue the conversation in the terminal or in Telegram (recommended).
